title: Twelve-bar blues in C major (simplified)
trains: The twelve-bar blues with three-note chords held a whole bar: four bars of I, two of IV, two of I, then V, IV, I, I. Count the bars: the form is what to learn. A simpler version of the next lesson, which uses sevenths.
